Physical media. Digital media exists for as long as the company hosting your digital media exists. So right now, I have about 40 movies "in the cloud" with Vudu. But when Vudu disappears (like a few other digital streaming sites have done), I am left with nothing. The inconvenience of popping in a DVD is well worth it to me because I can freely do with it as I please - watch it in 20 years, give it away, convert it and put it in the cloud, etc.

Cloud storage pros: host company handles backups, everything is available like one big video/music jukebox even when you're not at home.

Cloud storage cons: you own "virtual" media that can disappear overnight if the company abandons it, you are a slave to an internet connection and assume your internet doesn't go down or slows down, and you are literally downloading 2-4 GBs every time you watch a movie. Okay if you live alone and have a fast connection, but terrible if you have 20 other devices that shares that bandwidth. You also assume there will never be bandwidth data caps. Another thing: if you are hacked, someone can take or delete your media with simply your username and password. Would you even know the process to get back your identity?

Physical media pros: It's your media for as long as your media exists. You can always convert it later and still enjoy the same benefits of online streaming. To watch, pop it in your DVD player or PC DVD drive. Push play. No internet connection needed. Lend it, sell it, trade it, give it away. Hell, make a copy for yourself and others.

Physical media cons: prone to deterioration. If you do not make backups, it will be lost forever. You also need a player. It gets bulky when you have more than 1000 DVDs.

Edit: I just want to add that you will never get true high-definition playback of movies via online streaming despite what the marketing by Netflix, Google, Apple, etc. says. Same with your online music. A true HD stream over a Blu-ray is 10-20 MB/sec. Netflix streams HD content at 2.5MB/sec max. So if your music is so shitty that listening to mp3s is just as good as listening on CD or your movies are just as enjoyable watching in a compressed "HD-like" picture versus an actual HD picture over Blu-ray, then streaming is for you.
